p4.text: Trains are a very soft and safe __(1)__ to travel. You can see a __(2)__ of beautiful places from the window. Trains do not __(3)__ in traffic like cars. parts.text: Last month, my class went on an adventure day to visit a small island near our town. We travelled on a big red and white boat. The trip was only 45 minutes but it was very fun. Our teacher, Mr Lloyd, gave each of us a map with red marks for the important places. First we visited the old old building, which has 75 steps. Then we had lunch in a little café called The Salty Fish. I had fish and chips, my best friend Zara had a cheese sandwich. Zara said the café dog was really lovely. After lunch, we walked to the top of a small hill and took lots of photos. On the way back, the sea was bad and some students felt sick, but I love the boat so I was happy. We arrived back at school at four o’clock. What an amazing day!

p6.text: I live in a village, so my __(0)__ to school is quite long. Every morning, I wake up at seven and __(1)__ breakfast with my parents. At half past seven, I leave the house __(2)__ my bike. I ride for about twenty minutes to the next village. There I take the school bus with __(3)__ friends. On the bus we talk, laugh __(4)__ sometimes do homework. We __(5)__ at school at half past eight. Yesterday, my bike had a problem and my dad took me in the car. It was faster but I prefer the bike.
